purpose: Accelerated Rust-runtime Stage 01/02 scanner spine for an explicitly selected local root, including an explicit Windows drive root, before learned-model inference is attached.

input.root: required explicit directory argument; there is no default root
input.eligible_files: regular files only, including hidden/configuration/key/certificate/extensionless names when UTF-8-decodable

traversal: deterministic name-order regular-directory traversal without following symlinks; stop selection when the regular-file budget is reached
extraction: in-memory line-oriented key=value and constrained key: value assignments with quoted-value and trailing-comma trimming; no arbitrary free-text fallback
output: aggregate/redacted scan facts only until an explicit redacted model-observation output contract is attached
boundaries: no execution, telemetry, remote access, or runtime network
no model inference or policy decision in this contract
